### Fixed
- **The storage-version backup hook stops the 0.x kagent release from re-applying the CRDs it deletes** (giantswarm/agent-platform#416): on graveler's cut-over (giantswarm/giantswarm#37745, meta 3.23.1 → 4.9.1 through the cluster's Flux) the still-installed kagent 0.3.3 wrapper `HelmRelease` — `crds: CreateReplace`, in an upgrade-retry loop because the fleet's flag PR (`agentPlatform.kagentApiV2: true`) had landed before the bound lift, its render refused on every retry (`additional properties 'harness' not allowed`) — re-applied `modelconfigs`, `remotemcpservers` and `modelproviderconfigs.kagent.dev` one second after `<release>-kagent-storage-version-backup` had deleted them, and `kagent-crds` failed six times with `status.storedVersions[0]: Invalid value: "v1alpha2"` and stalled; recovery was by hand. The backup hook now patches `spec.install.crds` and `spec.upgrade.crds` to `Skip` on every `HelmRelease` a deleted CRD's `helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/name` + `namespace` labels name before it deletes (the 4.x manifest carries no crds policy for the kagent release: helm-controller's client-side three-way merge drops the patch on apply, a server-side apply leaves it inert on a release whose chart ships no `crds/`; a gone owner is tolerated), then watches the CRDs stay absent for 60 s — one that comes back is deleted again and the hook fails naming the owner, so Flux's retried upgrade finds them gone. Rehearsed on a 3.23.1 agentlab upgraded in place to this chart with the 0.x release held in the loop and reconciled every 5 s: the CRDs stayed absent, `kagent-crds` installed on its first attempt. `make verify-kagent-storage-version` asserts the patch, its order and the watch; `UPGRADE.md` ("3.x → 4.0", both sections) names the race and the order of the two fleet PRs. **Installations act**: none — the hook runs on the cut-over upgrade; an installation that lands the flag and the bound lift within one Flux interval never enters the loop at all.
